desc: Ideation: linearity decomposition by fixing value v and its right-set R
Catch fatal error in ideation: multiplicity is |R|!(N-1-|R|)!, not (N-1)!; corrected formula uses elementary symmetric sums e_k of {10^{d_u}}
Implement digit-length grouping: counts c[L] and value sums s[L] (mod MOD, use inv2 for arithmetic series)
Implement vectorized numpy NTT (bit-reversal, precomputed twiddles, inverse via inverse roots + inv_size) and build E(t)=∏_L(1+10^L t)^{c_L}
Compute per-length H=E/(1+a_L t) via h_k=(-a_L)^k * prefix-sum(e_i*(-a_L)^{-i}) using vectorized mod-pow arrays and cumsum
Combine: g_L=Σ_k k!(N-1-k)! h_k; answer=Σ_L s[L] g_L mod 998244353
Validate edge cases N=1→1, N=2→33, N=3→1332; ensure int64 no-overflow (all values < MOD before any product) and final stdin/stdout I/O

**Code review:** NTT size 2^18 ≥ N+1 prevents cyclic wraparound (deg E = N); bit-reversal correct for logn=1 edge case; all int64 products bounded by MOD² < 2^63; cumsum bounded by N·MOD < 2^63; pw_array doubling trick correct for non-power-of-two lengths; division formula h_k = (-a)^k·Σ_{i≤k} e_i(-a)^{-i} correctly implemented; weights w_k = fact[k]·fact[N-1-k] correctly indexed; exclusion of v depends only on its digit length, justifying the per-length grouping.
